Large deformation, distributed actuation, hysteresis, material variability and contact-rich interaction challenge both classical mechanics-based models and purely data-driven approaches. Here, we examine emerging modeling perspectives for soft manipulators through a conceptual progression from sparse identification of nonlinear dynamics to hybrid intelligence.
